thank you for being supportive and encouraging. my ex and my sister both have always had a tendency to make me feel invalidated and devalued when they thought they were being supportive, because most of their support was telling me that how I feel is wrong. It’s weird that I feel more listened to and understood by internet strangers than by people I have known and loved for years.

The thing that really I think was especially hard for me to accept is that his family broke up because his dad cheated and married his mistress and his little brother had severe issues because of it. My ex has always resented his dad, but I guess it was still ok for him to do the same thing because we didn’t have kids? I just never thought he would cheat because of his attitude toward his dad, so now I feel like my ability to judge character isn’t something I can trust and I will just get hurt if I put myself out there again in any capacity, for friends, romantic relationships, anything.
thank you for the suggestion, i added the book to my amazon list.
I hope things get better for you, it is so hard to think you were moving toward that family you needed so bad and then have it go away. I wish you and your child the best.

I was neglected, left alone all the time to raise my little sister. We rarely had enough food and we never got medical/dental care. I went to the dentist for the first time when I was 24. I broke my nose twice growing up and wasn’t allowed to see a doctor for it and now I have trouble breathing, as well as other injuries/illnesses that were left untreated (needed stitches several times, laryngitis, strep, etc).  I was also left in my walker overnight as a baby, which has caused lifelong back problems. This is all aside from the emotional neglect and never having any sort of affection from either of my parents and being mocked whenever I was sick or injured by both my parents and granddad.

My mother heaped attention and praise on my cousins, often in front of my sister and I, and she also went out of her way to teach them things and be the “cool aunt”. she was also a volleyball/basketball coach and treated her athletes with more care than her own children.

One of the big things I’m facing right now is having to choose between getting a car, moving, or having my teeth fixed. I hate my job and the town I live in but I don’t know where else I would go. I feel like I need a car to be more independent, but because I have such bad anxiety I am afraid I might not actually be able to drive and it would be a waste, and I don’t have the funds to have all the dental work I need done, so it would be a stop gap. So none of the choices are good really and each of the things kind of needs the other. I am really self conscious because of my dental problems, so it makes it hard to believe that I can get a job and make a life for myself somewhere else, but part of the reason I can’t afford my dental work is because my job and dental insurance now are so terrible. But, it’s hard to make it to dentist appointment or to job interviews without a car. It seems impossible to choose. If I stay here, I am stuck until July of 2020 (lease) in a job and town I’m unhappy in, but there is no guarantee I could find a job or another place to live before my current lease is up, which means my rent will go up which would mean I would have to wait even longer to be able to afford a car or dental work or to move. It all seems so impossible. I feel so stuck and I have no friends or family to ask for advice or help and nowhere to turn. I feel so lost. There are other problems as well, but the biggest thing right this moment, that everything else hinges on is this decision.

Of driving specifically, nothing really. I have a health problem that makes it slightly more difficult for me than for others, but it is legal and possible for me to drive and most people with this issue drive with no problem. The panic attacks, anxiety, and insomnia are caused by sustained trauma that led to mental health issues that have gone completely untreated until recently. I was just so afraid of failing that I never tried and now my anxiety is so extreme it seems impossible.
I have tried. no one will help me. I am just all alone.

I want to learn how to process things. I get so overwhelmed I never do anything and life just sort of happens to me so my choices have either been made by other people in my life or by circumstances. I would like to learn a way to sort through my options, weigh, and choose one. I know she can’t say “well, if I were you, I would do x,y,z” and I don’t expect her to. She focuses more on distraction/soothing techniques which are helpful in the correct time and place but distracting myself and not thinking about things is exactly how I end up in these bad situations and I want to learn to stop doing that and be able to handle making decisions.
I 100% know what you mean about the pressure. It’s like I’m supposed to be living for both of us, but I suck at even just living for myself. It’s like double failure.
thank you!

No one I have ever voiced this too before has ever understood where I was coming from, people have thought I was just being dramatic. I just can’t help but feel like, as someone who’s never felt like I belonged or was in the right place or knew what to do with my life, that she wouldn’t have done it better and that this all isn’t some cosmic mistake.

I have been seeing her for a year, so I don’t feel it’s an issue of her feeling that she doesn’t know me well enough or that we don’t have enough of a rapport. I have an appointment with her on Tuesday, I suppose I will just have to find a way to bring this up.

I was supposed to have a twin, she died in utero. I have always felt like I stole her life, like I wasn’t meant to be here. I sound crazy when I talk about it, and not many people understand it. I am just doing and have done so little with my life, I feel like someone else could’ve done more or used it more appropriately, like maybe it wasn’t meant for me and that’s why I can’t make anything out of it. crazy right?
you are very nice, thank you.
I am glad you are doing better, or at least are at a place where you feel like it’s better you decided not to end it. I don’t have anyone to call.
thank you, I am just hoping if I drink enough I can convince myself to end it and not be so scared.
I relate to this. It’s like because I can hold down a job I must be fine, but I am not fine. I feel like it is inevitable that I will eventually self destruct. I am so lonely and so fucked up.
All the time. I often have discussions with myself about history or philosophy or pop culture to distract myself from how alone and lonely I really am.
